The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 29 September 2024. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/jacek.szczesny.58). Car selfie; a political cap is not an obscene gesture. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot.
